products.title: PRE-ORDER: Bounty Sisters
products.body_html:
Releasing Fall 2026!

A brand new vertically scrolling shoot 'em up takes off with Bounty Sisters!

Welcome aboard this slapstick adventure that pits three bounty-hunting sisters against a band of villains!

Word is that Gunb Eleb, a highly wanted criminal with a huge bounty on his head, has gotten his hands on a giant mech, and has used it to take over the restored outskirts of Elenbaum. The bounty sisters, catching wind of this news, set out to Elenbaum, each with their trusty ride.

Pilot one of the three sisters' unique aircrafts, each possessing its own main and sub-weapons. Tackle the challenge alone or bring a friend along with local co-op. 

On your adventure, you'll face a plethora of gimmicks and giant creatures, with every stage evolving as you progress. But beware! There's a challenging boss at the end of each stage just waiting to shoot you out of the sky! Will you be able to stop the band of villains? Give it all you got and defeat them in thrilling sky battles in Bounty Sisters. 


Key Features

  • Take on the challenge alone or recruit a friend to take down the band of villains with local co-op. 
  • Find a loadout that matches your play style best by unlocking sub-weapons with coins you earn on each run!
  • The story and world of Bounty Sisters are brought to life through sweeping music from a talented sound team, paired with stunning character art from veteran artist Shuzilow.HA!
  • The three bounty-hunting sisters and the band of villains are all fully voiced in this comedic adventure for a full immersive experience!

products.title: PRE-ORDER: Tristia: Chronicles
products.body_html:
Tristia: Chronicles is coming to Nintendo Switch on September 17, 2026!

Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Legacy is a city building simulation game, you play as crafter-inventor Nanoca Flanka who has been challenged to restore the city within a year.  Will Tristia regain its former vibrancy or will it remain in disrepair? Everything depends on your hard work.

Tristia: Restore takes place alongside the story of Tristia: Legacy, but focuses on the day-to-day on-goings of Nanoca’s shop. She has some major crafting projects to complete, but while she works to finish them, a constant barrage of requests pour in. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?

KEY FEATURES

  • In Tristia: Legacy - buy, sell and create new items to help promote Tristia's economy; tackle larger projects as the city gains more funding.

  • In Tristia: Restore - finish the necessary project for each level in the time given, all while trying to balance the incoming barrage of side requests.

  • Play as Nanoca Flanka, and revitalize the city—your way. Build and manage a thriving city in Legacy, or dive into an action-packed adventure in Restore

  • Become close to the locals and be part of a rich cast of characters as you progress your Tristia restoration story.

products.title: PRE-ORDER: UNDERGROUNDED
products.body_html:
Undergrounded is coming to Nintendo Switch Fall 2026


Explore America's history... turned into a dungeon!

In UNDERGROUNDED, you play as Scott, a young man living in Manhattan who finally musters the courage to pop the question to his girlfriend... who promptly says no.

He's so dejected that he accidentally drops the ring he used to propose into a storm drain. And the ring falls deep underground, first through the sewers under Manhattan, Then through a movie theater? Past a Jet Plane? Through the Wild West? It turns out that deeep below Manhattan, there's an underground dungeon where America's past lives! Will you be able to make it all the way to the bottom to retrieve your ring?

Travel deeper and deeper through the different layers, solving puzzles with a great ally: a chatty, cheerful canary! As you venture deeper, you'll learn you're not the only one who's lost something in this dungeon, help them out and maybe, just maybe, Scott's life will change for the better as well. 

KEY FEATURES

  • Explore the many layers of America's history located underneath the sewers of Manhattan
  • Solve puzzles and adventure to the bottom with your trusty companion.
  • Defeat enemies & bosses through retro games inspired by 80s arcade masterpieces!
